errors.evidence: The description assigns the same color description, "тъмнолилав" (dark purple), to the slices "Да, непрекъснато" and "Да, веднъж месечно". In the figure, these two slices have distinct shades of purple; the slice for "Да, непрекъснато" is the darkest, while the slice for "Да, веднъж месечно" is a visibly lighter shade.
